entities.name: Query SAICAR synthetase
observations: 240 aa soluble protein; predicted molecular weight 27.68 kDa and pI 6.03.
Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt C0R444, annotated as phosphoribosylaminoimidazole-succinocarboxamide synthase.
Pfam PF01259.25 SAICAR_synt domain spans residues 7–234 with i-Evalue 1.3e-79.
Function is supported by 100% identity and 100% coverage to C0R444, not merely by remote homology.

entities.name: RHEA:22628
observations: 5-amino-1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)imidazole-4-carboxylate + L-aspartate + ATP → SAICAR [(2S)-2-[5-amino-1-(5-phospho-beta-D-ribosyl)imidazole-4-carboxamido]succinate] + ADP + phosphate + 2 H+.
This is the ATP-dependent ligation step catalyzed by phosphoribosylaminoimidazole-succinocarboxamide synthetase, EC 6.3.2.6.

entities.name: De novo IMP biosynthesis
observations: The enzyme catalyzes step 1 of 2 in conversion of phosphoribosylaminoimidazole-4-carboxylate toward 5-amino-1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)imidazole-4-carboxamide during de novo purine/IMP biosynthesis.

entities.name: SAICAR synthetase annotation
observations: Gene Ontology molecular function: phosphoribosylaminoimidazolesuccinocarboxamide synthase activity (GO:0004639).
